data.1: Wakurugenzi wanahusika katika kuandaa na kuwasilisha taarifa Wakurugenzi wamefanya tathmini ya shirika na uwezo wa za kifedha za kampuni ya East African Cables na washirika kampuni kuendelea kama yenye umuhimu na kwamba hawana wake kama ilivyoainishwa katika kurasa za 24 na 57 ambazo budi kuamini kuwa kampuni na washirika wake kwa jumla zinajumuisha taarifa za matokeo ya kifedha za Shirika na kampuni hawatakosa kujimudu kwa takriban miezi kumi na miwili ijayo kufikia tarehe 31 Desemba 2009, na taarifa kamilifu za mapato ya tangu kutolewa kwa taarifa hii. shirika; taarifa kuhusu mapato na matumizi ya fedha za mwaka huo uliomalizika pamoja na ufupisho wa sera muhimu za uhasibu Kuidhinishwa kwa taarifa za kifedha na taarifa nyingine zilizoelezewa. Taarifa za kifedha, kama ilivyoelezewa hapo juu, ziliidhinishwa na halmashauri ya wakurugenzi tarehe 25, Februari 2010 na kutiwa Majukumu ya wakurugenzi ni pamoja na: kuamua kuwa kanuni sahihi kwa niaba yake na: za uhasibu zilizoelezewa katika kijelezi 3 ni zenye kukubalika katika kuandaa na kuwasilisha taarifa za kifedha katika hali hizo; kutengeneza, kutekeleza na kudumisha udhibiti wa mambo ya ndani unaofaa katika kuandaa na kuwasilisha taarifa hizi za kifedha zisizo na makosa; aidha ya ulaghai au kasoro, pamoja na kuchagua na kutumia sera zinazofaa za uhasibu pamoja na Z.G. Mbugua George Mwangi kufanya ukadiriaji unaofaa wa hesabu katika hali hizo. (Mkurugenzi) (Mkurugenzi) Chini ya Sheria za Makampuni ya Kenya, Wakurugenzi wanahitajika kuandaa taarifa za kifedha za kila mwaka zinazobaini ukweli na mtazamo wa haki wa mambo ya shirika na ya kampuni kufikia mwisho wa mwaka huo na ule wa matokeo ya utendaji wa shirika ya mwaka huo. Vilevile, inawahitaji wakurugenzi kuhakikisha kuwa kampuni na washirika wake wanadumisha rekodi sawa za uhasibu ambayo inabainisha kwa uhakika unaofaa hali ya kifedha ya shirika na kampuni. Wakurugenzi wanawajibikia taarifa za kifedha za kila mwaka ambazo zimeandaliwa kutumia sera zinazofaa za uhasibu kwa kuzingatia maamuzi bora na yenye kufaa pamoja na ukadiriaji, ambao unakubalika na Viwango vya Kimataifa vya Uripoti wa Kifedha na inavyohitajika na sheria za makampuni ya Kenya. Wakurugenzi wanaonelea kuwa taarifa hizi za kifedha zinatoa mtazamo huru na wa haki kuhusiana na hali ya kifedha ya shirika na kampuni pamoja na ile ya matokeo kwa huduma za shirika. Zaidi, Wakurugenzi wanakubali wajibu wa kuhifadhi rekodi za uhasibu ambazo zinaweza kurejelewa katika matayarisho ya taarifa za kifedha, pamoja na mifumo ya kutosha ya udhibiti wa ndani. 15 East African Cables Limited | Annual Report & Financial Statements 2009

None Nina furaha vilevile kuripoti kwamba kufuatia ufanisi nchini huu kuwa shilingi moja kwa kila hisa, ambayo ni inawakilisha faida Kenya, kwa sasa, tunaratibu upya shughuli katika operesheni ya asilimia mia mbili (200%) kwa thamani ya hisa. za tawi letu la Tanzania; shughuli ambayo inatazamiwa kuzidisha kiwango cha uzalishaji na utendakazi mbali na kuangazia zaidi MATARAJIO YA BAADAYE soko la kibinafsi na ile ya kigeni ili kuimarisha ukuaji mbali na Mazingira ya biashara yanazidi kuibua changamoto mbalimbali kutuepusha na utegemezi wa wanunuzi kutoka nchini humo ambazo si ngeni kwa kampuni. Tunatazamia kuregea kwa uhitaji pekee. Kupungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa utendaji wa shirika hili katika masoko ya kieneo lakini pia tunahofu hali hii huenda kunatokana na utendaji katika tawi letu la Tanzania. Hata hivyo ikadhalilishwa na msukosuko wa hali ya juu wa bei za bidhaa hatua tayari zimewekwa ili kurekebisha hali hii. katika soko la kimataifa kama ilivyotajwa awali. Hata hivyo, bodi hii inasalia na imani kuu kuhusu hali ya baadaye. Na ili kuepuka KUZIDISHA UWEZO changamoto zilizotajwa awali, kampuni hii itaendelea kuwekeza Katika mwaka unaorejelewa, tuliwekeza kiasi cha shilingi milioni katika mikakati ambayo itaiwezesha kufikia utendakazi bora na 441 katika kiwanda kipya. Awamu ya mwisho ya mitambo kuiweka katika hali nzuri inayohitajika ili kutumia mifumo mipya inawekwa kwa sasa. Kiwanda hicho kitasaidia kuzidisha kiwango ambayo ni muhimu zaidi katika ushindani wetu wa kipindi kirefu. cha uzalishaji, utendakazi pamoja na kuongeza uwezo wa Tunatambua kwamba wateja wanatafuta thamani zaidi na kuzalisha bidhaa. Hatua hii itatuweka katika hali nzuri zaidi ya kwamba washindi wa kesho wanafaa kuwa na uwezo mbalimbali ushindani ili kutekeleza mpango wetu wa kupanua masoko yetu mbali na kukabiliana na mifumo ya masoko kwa ukakamavu. ikiwa ni pamoja na kudhibiti uwepo wetu sokoni katika nchi kumi Kuwekeza katika uhusiano na wateja pamoja na kujenga ubia na mbili kufikia mwaka wa 2012. Bodi ya wakurugenzi tayari dhabiti na washikadau kwa kutilia maanani biashara yenye imeelezea kuridhishwa na ufaafu wa mitambo mipya ikizingatiwa kuzingatia mazingira na jamii kutazidi kuongoza vigezo vyetu hali yao ya uzalishaji na mwoano wao ili kuweka viwango vipya vya vikuu daima. mabadiliko katika ubunifu hasa katika kuzalisha aina kadhaa za bidhaa, kama vile dhana ya kuzikinga nyaya kwa aina mbalimbali MACHAPISHO YA TAARIFA ZA KIFEDHA NA MATANGAZO za vifaa kwa kutumia mtambo mmoja tu. Tunatazamia kuona YA MIKUTANO MIKUU KWA NJIA YA KIELEKTRONIKI manufaa mema ya uwekezaji huu mwaka wa 2010. Mamlaka ya masoko ya mtaji iko katika harakati za kuzifanyia VIWANGO VYA KURIPOTI marekebisho sheria zake ili kuruhusu usambazaji wa taarifa Kampuni hii inaendelea kuzingatia uwasilishaji na toaji wa mahitaji za kifedha pamoja na matangazo ya mikutano mikuu kwa ya Halmashauri ya Kimataifa ya Uripoti wa Kifedha (IFRS) kama washikadau kwa njia ya kielektroniki na bodi ya wakurugenzi inavyohitajika na Taasisi ya Mahasibu Halali wa Umma nchini inapendekeza kwa washikadau kuidhinisha badiliko hilo katika Kenya (ICPAK). Mabadiliko na ustawi katika halmashauri hiyo sheria za kampuni kuhusiana na swala hili. katika kipindi cha matumizi ya pesa cha mwaka ulioangaziwa, yametekelezwa. SHUKURANI Shukurani kuu ziwaendee wateja wetu, wasambazaji wa bidhaa TUZO NA UTAMBUZI zetu na wadau wote kwa kutuunga mkono katika mwaka Kampuni hii kwa mara nyingine ilishiriki katika mashindano ya tuzo uliopita; wasimamizi na wafanyakazi kwa kujitolea kwao, bidii na ya ubora katika uripoti wa kifedha (FIRE) ambayo yanadhaminiwa uaminifu wao kazini na hatimaye kwa wakurugenzi wenzangu na soko la hisa la Nairobi, mamlaka ya masoko ya mtaji nchini kwa kutuunga mkono, uongozi na uelekezi wao. Kwa kiwango Kenya pamoja na Taasisi ya Mahasibu Halali wa umma nchini cha uwajibikaji kilichodhihirishwa na kila mshikadau, tuna imani Kenya. Nina furaha kuwajulisha kwamba kampuni hii iliibuka ya kwamba tutazipiku changamoto zinazotukabili na kuibuka na pili katika kitengo cha Viwanda, Mauzo na Huduma. Mashindano matokeo bora zaidi mwaka ujao. Tusonge mbele pamoja. hayo yanalenga kuibuka na maoni huru kuhusu viwango vya uripoti wa kifedha. Nachukua fursa hii kuwashukuru wasimamizi kwa kujitolea kwao kuiimarisha kampuni, hali ambayo imepelekea tuzo hii. RIBA Z.G. Mbugua Nina furaha kuripoti kwamba bodi ya wakurugenzi inapendekeza Mwenyekiti kwa mkutano mkuu wa mwaka, riba ya mwisho ya senti hamsini Bodi ya Wakurugenzi kwa kila hisa. Hii ni nyongeza kwa riba ya awali ya muda ambayo ilikuwa ya senti hamsini kwa kila hisa na ambayo ililipwa mwezi Desemba mwaka wa 2009. Hii inafikisha jumla ya riba mwaka 19 East African Cables Limited | Annual Report & Financial Statements 2009 None None None

SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES The accounting policies set out below have been applied consistently to all periods presented in these financial statements: (a) Basis of preparation (i) Statement of compliance The financial statements are prepared in accordance with and comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). (ii) Basis of Measurement The financial statements have been prepared on the historical cost basis as modified by revaluation of certain property, plant and equipment and investment property. (iii) Functional and presentation currency Items included in the financial statements of each of the Group’s entities are measured using the currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates (“the functional currency”). The consolidated financial statements are presented in Kenya Shillings (KShs), which is the Company’s functional and presentation currency. (iv) Use of estimates and judgement The preparation of financial statements in conformity with International Financial Reporting Standards requires management to make judgement, estimates and assumptions that affect the application of policies and reported amounts of assets and liabilities and disclosures of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reported period. The estimates and assumptions are based on the Directors’ best knowledge of current events, actions, historical experience and various other factors that are believed to be reasonable under the circumstances, the results of which form the basis of making the judgements about the carrying values of assets and liabilities are not readily apparent from other sources. Actual results may differ from these estimates. The estimates and underlying assumptions are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Revisions to accounting estimates are recognised in the period which the estimate is revised if the revision affects only that period or in the period of the revision and future periods if the revision affects both current and future periods. (b) Revenue recognition (i) Goods sold Revenue from the sale of goods is measured at the fair value of the consideration receivable, net of returns, trade discounts and volume rebates. Revenue is recognised when the significant risk and rewards of ownership have been transferred to the buyer, recovery of the consideration is probable, the associated costs and possible return of goods can be estimated reliably, there is no continuing management involvement with the goods, and the amount of revenue can be measured reliably. Transfers of risks and rewards vary depending on the individual terms of the contract of sale. Sales are generally recognised upon delivery of products and are stated net of Value Added Tax (VAT). (ii) Rental income Rental income on the investment property is recognised in the statement of comprehensive income on a straight line basis over the term of the lease. (c) Consolidation principles The consolidated financial statements include the Company (which also includes a branch in Uganda) and its subsidiary, East African Cables (Tanzania) Company Limited in which the Group holds 51% of the voting rights and Yana Trading Company Limited in which the company holds 100% voting rights (refer to Note 18). Subsidiaries are entities controlled by the Company. Control exists when the Company has the power, directly or indirectly, to govern the financial and operating policies of an entity so as to obtain benefits from its activities. In assessing control, potential voting rights that are currently exercisable are taken into account. The financial statements of the subsidiaries are included in the consolidated financial statements from the date that control commences until that control ceases. 31 East African Cables Limited | Annual Report & Financial Statements 2009 None None None
